name: Hybrid Syndrome
source:
Those with white wings, called angels, and those with black wings, called devils, coexist in this world. Both groups are very prideful, and ostracize each other.

Raum, a boy who was born from the union of an angel and devil, lives his life without anywhere to go.

One day, he recieves a letter of admission from a school where both tribes seem to coexist. Urged on by his friend Ciel, an angel, the two of them decide to enter the school. Hiding his status as a hybrid, Raum engages with both angels and devils...

[translated from DLsite]
translation:
在这个世界，拥有白色翅膀、被称为天使的一族，与拥有黑色翅膀、被称为恶魔的一族共同生活。双方都十分自负，彼此排斥。

劳姆是天使与恶魔结合所生的少年，却始终无处容身。

一天，他收到一所学校的录取通知书，据说天使与恶魔在那里能够共存。在天使朋友席尔的劝说下，两人决定一同入学。劳姆隐瞒了自己的混血身份，开始与天使和恶魔们往来…

[译自DLsite]
